title: QA Testing Edge Cases
author: johnesco
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/0lpepy4vgunh1.png?width=761&format=png&auto=webp&s=a5b36e2ceceab0c9df2f52868632c40a38fd20fd

Well of course things can be tested headlessly, or in other automated methods. there is no cooler feeling for me than verifying "Hey CAN I cross the finish line RIGHT as the timer hits zero?" in an actual playthrough.  


How are you testing your game? Playthroughs? Automation? Bot testing? AI directly playing your game? I use a mixture myself and wanted to know how other people are playtesting with ai (ok ok vibe testing?)

Also if someone is looking for someone older than Atari to play their game and give feedback, let me know.
